    • expiresAt

      public abstract ClaudeFile.Builder expiresAt(Instant expiresAt)
      Setter for expiresAt.

      expiresAt: Output only. The time at which the file expires and is deleted, set from the `expires_in_seconds` upload form field. Unset for files that do not expire, which is serialised as `null`.

    • filename

      public abstract ClaudeFile.Builder filename(String filename)
      Setter for filename.

      filename: Output only. The original name of the uploaded file, taken from the `Content-Disposition` header on upload. Between 1 and 255 characters. Control characters and the characters `<>:"|?*\/` are not accepted.

    • clearFilename

      @CanIgnoreReturnValue public ClaudeFile.Builder clearFilename()
